description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 225.00 each), grants [Awoken Unequaled Prince Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ninja +30% Boost (15s)] and [Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water, Poison)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Unequaled Prince Mode
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses, Ninja abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, chases ninja abilities with Eblan Style Kassatsu Jizai

description.name: Eblan Style Kassatsu Jizai
description.text: 4/6/8 single hybrid attacks (0.67 or 414.1 each) under 0/1/2 physical blink

description.name: Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Water, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Water/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
